approved_by: Jason, 2026-10-28 ("go with it" on the Phase 2 plan, Q6)
applies_to: SC-FUT-0005 noise-area momentum, MNQ, workbench practice data 2019-05..2024-12 only
written_before: any SC-FUT-0005 Phase 2 (cash) result. Inputs used: the worst practice day at 1 MNQ ($629, independent review 2026-10-27) and Topstep's published thresholds; no cash or pass-rate result chooses a number below.
cushion: equity at the start of the day minus the account's current loss floor (Combine or XFA)

P3_cushion.size: clamp(floor(cushion / 629), 1, 5): the worst practice day must fit inside the cushion; size drops after losses and grows once the floor locks

P4_cushion_dll.note: $1,000 daily loss limit set at Combine purchase: caps the day, carried into the XFA, doubles payout caps

P5_cushion_dll_stop.profit_stop_scope: Combine only: flatten and stop for the day once the day's P&L reaches +$1,500, keeping the best day under the 55% consistency line ($1,650 of the $3,000 target). Off in the XFA.

luck: each policy x plan x path is applied unchanged to the random-direction control on the same resampled days
selection_rule: among the 20 cells, pick the one with the highest lower 90% bound of (net cash - luck net cash); ties broken by the shorter median days to first payout. A cell is eligible only if its lower bound is > $0 and its median first payout is <= 42 days. If no cell is eligible, no size is chosen and the exam check is not spent.
trials: every cell is one ledger trial (20); the family's honesty counter rises by 20
exam: only the selected cell is run once on 2025-26, and only after Jason's go-ahead
